title: 1800 case: balls of light come out of the water
summary: Kevin Knuth tells of 1800 case: balls of light come out of the water, about 1800 at at sea, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: This case dates back to 1800. Balls of light emerging from the water, hovering alongside the craft, following the craft, and then taking off into the clouds.

plain: A physicist who studies UFO reports, Kevin Knuth, describes a case he dates to the year 1800, at sea. According to him, balls of light rose out of the water, hovered beside a ship, followed it, and then shot off into the clouds. He tells it to show that such sightings go back long before modern aircraft.
